Squads:

Arshdeep Singh to Darwish Rasooli, out Caught by Tilak Varma!! Another one bites the dust. This looked like Darwish Rasooli had got it off the meat, but wasn't. Hits the toe end as he looks to go straight down the ground to a full delivery on off-stump. Was just short of a yorker, which made it hard for Rasooli to get under. Tilak runs to his right and grabs it just in front of the boundary at long-off. Darwish Rasooli c Tilak Varma b Arshdeep Singh 26(15) [4s-1 6s-2]
Rashid Khan, right handed bat, comes to the crease

Arshdeep Singh to Mohammad Nabi, no run, length delivery on off-stump, Mohammad Nabi gets squared on as he looks to defend. The ball rolls towards cover

Arshdeep Singh to Mohammad Nabi, 2 runs, Shreyas Iyer has a shy at the striker's end and he misses, allowing the duo to sneak in for an extra run. This was tapped in front of the fielder for a quick single
Arshdeep Singh to Mohammad Nabi, 1 run, half-volley outside off, Mohammad Nabi drills it to the left of mid-off. Tilak dives to his left and saves runs

Ravi Bishnoi to Rashid Khan, no run, googly from Ravi Bishnoi. Rashid gets forward and looks to drive, gets a thick inside edge onto the pads
Ravi Bishnoi to Rashid Khan, 1 run, fuller outside off, Rashid leans onot the front foot and knocks it down to long-off

Ravi Bishnoi to Mohammad Nabi, FOUR, Bishnoi sees the batter move away trying to make room and bowls it wide of off. Mohammad Nabi throws his bat at the wide delivery and gets a thick outside edge that runs down to third man fence
Ravi Bishnoi to Mohammad Nabi, SIX, rank long hop from Bishnoi that sits up nicely to be hit. Nabi picks the wrong'un and pulls it way into deep mid-wicket stands. Afghanistan need more of these
Ravi Bishnoi to Mohammad Nabi, no run, Nabi backsaway and taps it to backward point
Ravi Bishnoi to Mohammad Nabi, no run, fuller outside off at 102ks, Nabi chops it of the inside edge down to short third man
